goal: Run two complete v0.5 browser-account regression rounds and prepare a verified Chrome Web Store ZIP only if both rounds pass

constraints.cleanup: Restore every test-only setting and reversible X action before the round ends
constraints.packageGate: Do not create the final store ZIP unless both browser rounds pass

tasks.task: Confirm the clean v0.5 source baseline, installed-browser test surface, strategy matrix, and release commands
tasks.verify: Git state, package/manifest version, existing tests, build scripts, installed extension state, and signed-in X page are all directly inspected

tasks.task: Run browser-account regression round 1 across master enablement, bubble/position, scope, auto tier, badge, local hide/undo, X mute, X block, options navigation, and responsive/dark interaction states
tasks.verify: Each strategy produces its documented result on a real X page, console has no new extension errors, and desktop/mobile screenshots are captured

tasks.task: Repeat the complete strategy and interaction regression independently after restoring the baseline
tasks.verify: The same matrix passes a second time with fresh page state, no retained test-only setting/action, no new console errors, and new screenshots

tasks.task: Build the final Chrome Web Store ZIP from the exact twice-tested source state
tasks.verify: Compile, extension tests, production build, package command, ZIP listing, manifest policy fields, size, SHA-256, and secret scan all pass

tasks.task: Attempt to falsify every prior pass before declaring store readiness
tasks.verify: Re-run critical tests, inspect evidence files, compare packaged manifest to source policy, confirm clean Git diff, and verify the ZIP can be opened
